dict.modelReasoningHelpText: The API value is sent in the request's reasoning-effort field, such as OpenAI's reasoning_effort. It defaults to the level name; where the model provider's API documentation specifies a different value, follow it. Off turns reasoning off and needs no value; a value already written in the configuration is kept and sent.
dict.modelReasoningNeedsLevel: Add at least one level besides Off, or turn reasoning levels off.
dict.modelReasoningValueRequired: Every level besides Off needs an API value, and no value can be empty.
dict.modelsEmpty: Hiç modeller will be shown in the seçor. Unlisteed IDs can still be sent directly.

dict.welcomeBody:
DeepSeek Harness 0.1 remains in testing for Harness developers. Many areas need further improvement, and we welcome feedback from the developer community. DeepSeek Harness's core eklentis and foundational APIs will continue to evolve rapidly over the coming months.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence with developers around the world, building on open-source, open, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome Harness developers everywhere to join the DSH eklenti ecosystem.
